taxon.note: Scientific and common names (and USDA symbol) as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact: one year, as the plant is an annual.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

generator.params.note: From California poppy's, changed for an opium poppy's form: one erect stout stem (Flora of China vol. 7, Papaver somniferum: stems erect; Flora of North America vol. 3: stems simple or branching), 9 stem leaves 20 cm at the largest (FoC: blade 7-25 cm), the largest low on the stem and the upper ones half as long (FoC: leaves below shortly petiolate, above sessile and amplexicaul), over 3 basal leaves (FNA Papaver: basal leaves rosulate); the top two leaves each bear a flowering side branch with one leaf (FNA Papaver: flowers in 1s, 2s or 3s on long peduncles), and each flowering axis ends in a long bare peduncle, its top 30 percent (FoC: pedicel to 25 cm); its flower turns to a capsule over the season, by the flowering and fruiting months. Stem radius 5 mm for its stout stem. Not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: 0.8 m tall in its one year in the open, inside Flora of China's 30-60(-100) cm and FNA's to 15 dm. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

appearance.note: Colours from Flora of China vol. 7, Papaver somniferum (read on eFloras, 2026-10-19): stems and leaves glaucous and rather waxy, so a grey blue-green for both. The leaf cards: simple blades, the stem leaves sessile (FoC: above sessile and amplexicaul), the basal ones shortly stalked; their outline and teeth are left to the rules from leaf_shape and leaf_margin.

traits.height_typical_m.note: Flora of China vol. 7 (2008), Papaver somniferum (read on eFloras, 2026-10-19): herbs 30-60(-100) cm tall (to 1.5 m in cultivation); 0.8 m read as typical of a flowering plant grown in the open.

traits.height_max_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 3 (1997), Papaver somniferum (read on eFloras, 2026-10-19): plants to 15 dm; Flora of China agrees (to 1.5 m in cultivation).

traits.life_span.note: Flora of China vol. 7 (2008), Papaver somniferum: herbs, annual.

traits.woodiness.note: Flora of China vol. 7 (2008), Papaver somniferum: herbs.

traits.leaf_arrangement.note: Flora of China vol. 7 (2008), Papaver somniferum: leaves alternate.

traits.leaf_division.note: Flora of China vol. 7 (2008), Papaver somniferum: blade ovate or oblong, one undivided blade.

traits.leaf_incision.note: Flora of China vol. 7 (2008), Papaver somniferum: margin irregularly undulate-serrate, the blade not lobed; FNA: margins shallowly to deeply toothed.

traits.leaf_shape.note: Flora of China vol. 7 (2008), Papaver somniferum: blade ovate or oblong, base cordate; oblong taken.

traits.leaf_margin.note: Flora of China vol. 7 (2008), Papaver somniferum: margin irregularly undulate-serrate.

traits.leaf_length_m.note: Flora of China vol. 7 (2008), Papaver somniferum: blade 7-25 cm; FNA gives leaves to 30 cm.

traits.leaf_hairs.note: Flora of China vol. 7 (2008), Papaver somniferum: both surfaces glabrous, glaucous and rather waxy.

traits.rosette.note: Flora of North America vol. 3 (1997), Papaver (read on eFloras, 2026-10-19): leaves basal rosulate, petiolate; cauline alternate.

traits.inflorescence.note: Flora of China vol. 7 (2008), Papaver somniferum: flowers solitary.

traits.flower_posture.note: Flora of China vol. 7 (2008), Papaver somniferum: flower buds nutant at first, erect at anthesis.

traits.flower_size_m.note: Flora of China vol. 7 (2008), Papaver somniferum: flowers deeply cup-shaped, 5-12 cm in diameter.

traits.petal_length_m.note: Flora of China vol. 7 (2008), Papaver somniferum: petals 4-7 x 3-11 cm.

traits.petal_shape.note: Flora of China vol. 7 (2008), Papaver somniferum: petals suborbicular or almost flabellate.

traits.corolla_shape.note: Flora of China vol. 7 (2008), Papaver somniferum: flowers deeply cup-shaped.

traits.flower_colour.note: Flora of China vol. 7 (2008), Papaver somniferum: petals white, pink, red, purple, or various; FNA the same. A pale lilac-pink taken, between white and purple. The colour is our reading of the words.

traits.perianth_base_colour.note: Flora of China vol. 7 (2008), Papaver somniferum: petals often with a dark basal blotch; FNA: often with dark or pale basal spot. A dark purple taken. The colour is our reading of the words.

traits.anther_colour.note: Flora of China vol. 7 (2008), Papaver somniferum: anthers yellowish or cream; FNA: anthers pale yellow. The colour is our reading of the words.

traits.filament_colour.note: Flora of China vol. 7 (2008), Papaver somniferum: filaments white, linear, 1-1.5 cm.

traits.flower_symmetry.note: Flora of China vol. 7 (2008), Papaver somniferum: petals 4, alike, the stigmas actinomorphic.

traits.petal_whorls.note: Flora of China vol. 7 (2008), Papaver somniferum: petals 4; with the family's merosity 2 (sepals 2), two whorls of two, the outer and inner pair.

traits.hypanthium.note: Flora of North America vol. 3 (1997), Papaveraceae (read on eFloras, 2026-10-19): a receptacular cup only in Eschscholzia, Meconella and Platystemon; Papaver has none.

traits.carpels.note: Flora of North America vol. 3 (1997), Papaver somniferum (read on eFloras, 2026-10-19): stigmas 5-18 on a more or less flat disc, one per carpel (Papaver: pistil 3-18-carpellate).

traits.fruit_type.note: Flora of North America vol. 3 (1997), Papaver somniferum: capsules stipitate, subglobose.

traits.fruit_shape.note: Flora of North America vol. 3 (1997), Papaver somniferum: capsules subglobose, not ribbed; Flora of China: spherical or oblong-elliptic, 4-9 x 4-5 cm.

traits.fruit_size_m.note: Flora of China vol. 7 (2008), Papaver somniferum: capsule 4-9 x 4-5 cm; FNA: to 9 cm.

traits.fruit_colour_ripe.note: Flora of China vol. 7 (2008), Papaver somniferum: capsule brown when mature; Simpson figures it tan-brown. The colour is our reading of the words.

traits.calyx_in_fruit.note: Flora of North America vol. 3 (1997), Papaveraceae: sepals caducous, so none stays under the fruit.

traits.flowering_months.note: Flora of North America vol. 3 (1997), Papaver somniferum: flowering spring-summer, read as May to August for the flora's range; Flora of China gives March to August.

traits.fruiting_months.note: A month after each flowering month, as no source read gives fruiting months: the capsule ripens after the petals fall.

provenance.notes: Procedural proxy (poppies, 2026-10-19) from the California poppy's form, its traits from Flora of China vol. 7 and Flora of North America vol. 3 (species, genus and family). Calibration against measurements and photographs is milestone P4.
